propositions: Close gate verification fails with exhausted search budget and insufficient evidence instead of automatically retrying with a fresh budget seeded by cached passes
The insufficiency-only verdict classification already exists in the framework but is not used to trigger auto-resumption at the shared close-gate seam
A bounded resumption loop (configurable by verify.auto_resume_max, default 2) should re-invoke verify_completion when only evidence insufficiency is detected, not genuine criterion refutation
Resumptions must respect a strict progress condition: re-run only if the prior attempt increased the cache-credited pass count, otherwise surface the failure to the operator
The resumption trail (attempt number, cache-credited criteria count, remaining unmet count) must be recorded and visible in close output and verdict metadata
